samples.xml_description:
<module id="accu">
    <description>Accumulate four input data and output.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset.</input>
        <input id="data_in" width_description="[7:0]">Input data.</input>
        <input id="valid_in">Valid input.</input>
        <output id="valid_out">Valid output.</output>
        <output id="data_out" width_description="[9:0]">Output data.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="WAIT_CYCLE">Wait cycle.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="cnt" width_description="[1:0]">Counter.</reg>
        <reg id="valid_out">Valid output.</reg>
        <reg id="data_out" width_description="[9:0]">Output data.</reg>
        <always>
            <if>
                <test>rst_n == 0</test>
                <then>
                    <assign>cnt = 0</assign>
                    <assign>valid_out = 0</assign>
                    <assign>data_out = 0</assign>
                </then>
                <else>
                    <if>
                        <test>valid_in == 1</test>
                        <then>
                            <if>
                                <test>cnt == 3</test>
                                <then>
                                    <assign>cnt = 0</assign>
                                    <assign>valid_out = 1</assign>
                                    <assign>data_out = data_out + data_in</assign>
                                </then>
                                <else>
                                    <assign>cnt = cnt + 1</assign>
                                    <assign>valid_out = 0</assign>
                                    <assign>data_out = data_out + data_in</assign>
                                </else>
                            </if>
                        </then>
                        <else>
                            <assign>valid_out = 0</assign>
                        </else>
                    </if>
                </else>
            </if>
        </always>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>Reset cnt, valid_out, data_out. When valid_in is 1, accumulate data_in to data_out. When cnt reaches 3, reset cnt to 0, set valid_out to 1, and accumulate data_in to data_out.</implementation>
</module>
